objective: Phase 8: Package a reviewer-ready artifact and reproducible paper asset pipeline
acceptance_criteria: requirements.lock freezes exact pinned versions of all dependencies
CITATION.cff provides standard citation metadata for the artifact and paper

scripts/build_paper_assets.py generates publication-ready LaTeX tables (table1_main_results.tex, table2_external_benchmarks.tex, table3_delegation_metrics.tex, table4_component_latency.tex) and figures in paper/ from machine-generated summaries with input integrity validation
artifact/README.md and artifact/INSTALL.md provide a comprehensive reviewer guide covering prerequisites, model setup, output layout, execution times, safety guarantees, and troubleshooting
artifact/run.sh and artifact/run.ps1 provide one-command reproduction verifying dependencies, running tests, executing evaluation profiles, and generating paper assets
artifact/expected/ stores golden reference summaries for automated comparison
scripts/reproduce.sh and scripts/reproduce.ps1 provide top-level reproduction entrypoints
non_goals: Do not modify frozen evaluation semantics or security properties established in phases 1-7
